title: Crash when running in editor related to GDExtension and Thread
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1-stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - macOS Sonoma (14.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon Pro 560X - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8850H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

When instantiating new GDExtension object in thread, editor run crashes randomly.

Here is the sample code. YourClass inherits RefCounted and is defined in C++. It works find when instantiating in main thread. But crash occasionally when in worker thread.

```
extends Node

var ts := []

func _ready() -> void:
    
    for i in 4:
        var t = Thread.new()
        t.start(test_yc)
        ts.append(t)
        
        
func test_yc():
    var yc = YourClass.new()
    yc.foo()
```
